data.long_meaning: Dilkash is a beautiful and charming name, derived from the Persian word 'dil' meaning heart and 'kash' meaning to win or capture. This name is often used to describe someone who is loved deeply and possesses the ability to win over the hearts of others. It is a name that embodies beauty, grace, and the power of love. The name Dilkash carries the meaning “Delight, Charm, Beautiful, Beloved” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi. Parents who choose Dilkash usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, charm, beautiful, beloved and live with faith, good character and purpose.
